description:
2026 NEW FEATURES: NEW CrossX Handlebar = most comfy upright positions with a cross bar + mount your favorite accessories, phone, lights etc. NEW Straight Blade Forks with Hydraulic DISC Brakes ALUMINUM CRANKSETS Compare to Specialized FX hybrid, Trek and Giant hybrid/lifestyle bicycles $800 and up

NEW XRSeries Aluminum Frame, lighter, higher performance with comfortable semi-upright geometry. Precision welded and shaped for responsive performance with comfort. Choose semi-compact geometry for a more upright ride, or LoRise for easy step-through clearance.

NEW 8 Speed Shimano or MicroShift Drivetrain: Advanced 1BY drivetrains for reliable shifting, lighter weight and less maintenance. Powerful Hydraulic DISC Brakes and rear rack mounts make it a great commuter, lifestyle or super-hybrid bike.

The custom X-Rod saddle has a wide ergonomic shape and elastomer suspension to absorb road buzz. This ~$79 value, ultra comfort saddle is included standard.
